what_happened: The seed report (01_seed-audit-findings.md) pre-measured activation surface, grant counts, tagged-write dates, and context-scoping probe outcomes across all six loaded repositories before this research dispatch started, eliminating the need to re-run verify-sapience-mcp.sh and verify-sapience-context-scoping.sh per repo; this dispatch only needed to read source files and cross-reference open-task descriptions.

Task 637's own description frames a RESIDUAL_HOLDS result from verify-sapience-context-scoping.sh as something the task must eliminate, but that script's own header and context/project/sapience/domain/injection-site-scoping.md both document RESIDUAL_HOLDS as the EXPECTED, already-accepted green state today (the only remedy is an external vendor change, already drafted as an Owner Action message); there is no local code path that turns it into RESIDUAL_LIFTED.
